links.comparator_used: Implicit weighting baseline (raw probabilities) and static expert-derived weighting, compared head-to-head against dynamic clinician-determined weighting
links.outcome: Perceived clinical utility and data-informed revision of physicians' initial unassisted antidepressant choices
links.effect: Dynamic weighting significantly enhanced perceived clinical utility vs alternatives (p < 0.01) and led to the most frequent data-informed revision of initial choices (33.3% of cases), in both psychiatrists and primary care physicians
links.quote: The Dynamic Clinician-Determined Weighting scheme significantly enhanced perceived clinical utility compared with the alternative approaches (p < 0.01).

design_hint: clinician-adjustable weighting of decision support outputs
